many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    seed=min((k for k in cnt if k!=base), key=lambda k:cnt[k])
    pts=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (base,seed)]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r,c in [(rr,cc) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[rr][cc]==seed]:
        for i in range(ph):
            for j in range(pw):
                ri=r+i-(ph-1)//2; ci=c+j-(pw-1)//2
                if 0<=ri<H and 0<=ci<W: o[ri][ci]=pat[i][j]
    return o
